evidence_boundary.untouched_evidence: artifact-sealed future OANDA LIVE zero-order shadow only
evidence_boundary.version_rule: V2 results may inform V3 only; V2 bytes and scores are never rewritten

split.label_crossing: forbidden; positions are liquidated at the owning split boundary

chronology.provider_timestamp: OANDA candle time is the candle-open timestamp
chronology.decision: after completed bar t at row[t].time + 5 minutes
chronology.entry: next bar t+1 open, exactly the decision boundary in this bar replay; LONG at ASK and SHORT at BID
chronology.exit: fill_index + H - 1 close at row[exit].time + 5 minutes; LONG at BID and SHORT at ASK
chronology.gap_policy: any non-5-minute step from decision through exit is DATA_GAP_UNSCORABLE
chronology.same_pair_config_inventory: at most one position; a signal whose next open overlaps an existing position is skipped

features.mid: OHLC midpoint of BID and ASK
features.ema_direction: d_t=sign(EMA3_t-EMA12_t); equality emits no source signal
features.thresholds: pair x UTC-session PE Q33/Q67 and RV Q33/Q67 from calibration only

break_state.ambiguity: multiple directions, missing values, or a non-contiguous 14-bar context is UNKNOWN and emits no break-gated signal

C4.gate: ASIA and PE>=Q67 and RV Q33<=RV<Q67

C5.gate: LONDON and PE>=Q67 and RV Q33<=RV<Q67

C6.gate: break rejection direction=-d_t and PE>=Q67 and RV Q33<=RV<Q67

C7.gate: break acceptance direction=d_t and PE>=Q67 and RV>=Q67

execution_arms.RAW_SIGNAL: mid open to mid close; no spread, fee, or slippage
execution_arms.EXECUTABLE_BASE: observed BID/ASK plus 0.3 pip slippage per side
execution_arms.ADVERSE_STRESS: same signal and path with observed BID/ASK plus 0.9 pip slippage per side
execution_arms.lineage: identical signal_id, side, entry index, and exit index in all three arms

costs.raw: mid prices with zero spread, fee, and slippage

portfolio.jpy_conversion: JPY-quoted PnL direct; USD-quoted PnL uses latest completed USD_JPY midpoint at or before each mark
portfolio.margin_model: none; fixed-unit accounting may cross zero and is diagnostic rather than executable-capital evidence

selection.lcb: UTC-decision-day mean minus z_(1-0.05/8) times the standard error of UTC-day means
selection.all_nonpositive_lcb: retain best diagnostic config as REJECTED_NO_GROSS_EDGE; never replace it using BASE or ADVERSE

gross_edge_gate.shadow_challenger_eligible: gross edge gate only; never admission

development_labels.GROSS_EDGE_FOUND_DEVELOPMENT_ONLY: tuning and opened development both pass RAW gross and density gates
development_labels.GROSS_ONLY_COST_BOUND: gross gate passes but opened-development BASE LCB is not positive
development_labels.BASE_EXECUTABLE_CANDIDATE: gross gate plus opened-development BASE expectancy and LCB are positive
development_labels.STRESS_ROBUST_CANDIDATE: base candidate plus opened-development ADVERSE expectancy and LCB are positive

shadow_addition_requires: new challenger arm while old baseline remains
future_evidence_gate.final_target: normal and adverse both >=2.0 equity multiple per full comparable month; not a tuning objective
